label: Interstellar bubbles
description: Separately loaded, source-backed shell models of large cavities in the interstellar medium.

sources.name: O'Neill et al. (2024); 3D dust-traced Local Bubble shell
O'Neill et al. (2024); interactive Figure 3 peak-extinction surface
Wolleben (2007); Loop I as two synchrotron shells, S2 parameters
Pon et al. (2016); Kompaneets model fits to the Orion–Eridanus superbubble
Bialy et al. (2021); Per-Tau Shell in the Leike et al. (2020) 3D dust map

cutoffPolicy: The Local Bubble and the three major neighboring shells with published 3D geometry: Loop I, the Orion–Eridanus Superbubble and the Per-Tau Shell. The Local Bubble surface is a 128 by 64 directional downsampling of the authors' published 786,392-sightline Figure 3 point cloud; the others are the published sphere or Kompaneets models.
snapshot: J2000 Galactic frame; Local Bubble Figure 3 source commit 52aa44614f3036b90fab8fd1beed996d285a7995, reviewed 2026-10-04; Loop I, Orion–Eridanus and Per-Tau models reviewed 2026-11-13.
